name: gbXML Summary Agent
description: Creates a concise, user-facing summary of the gbXML MCP result and writes it to blackboard.summary.

skills.name: Summarize gbXML Result
skills.description: Reads blackboard fields (tool_name, gbxml_path, surface_id, construction_id, gbxml_result_msg). Produces a one-paragraph summary at blackboard.summary that restates the tool invoked and identifiers, and—when present—extracts and reports key numbers (area in m², tilt in degrees, R-value in m²·K/W). If numeric parsing is not possible, include gbxml_result_msg verbatim with concise context.
examples: Summarize: tool_name=get_surface_area, gbxml_path=./gbxml_file/SF_model_Output_OS.xml, surface_id=ceiling_unit1_Reversed, gbxml_result_msg='Surface ID: ceiling_unit1_Reversed\nArea: 152.4 m²'.
Summarize: tool_name=get_surface_tilt, surface_id=Srf-123, gbxml_result_msg='Surface ID: Srf-123\nTilt: 15 degrees'.
Summarize: tool_name=get_surface_insulation, surface_id=Wall-101, gbxml_result_msg='Surface ID: Wall-101\nR-value: 2.35 m²·K/W'.
